title: Special Executive Programme In Engagement Of Employees And Organizational Learning
description: The aim of this Special Executive course is to unlock the Secrets of Employee Engagement and Organisational Knowledge Management.
longDescription: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of effective employee engagement and the role of organizational learning in driving success. Participants will explore the key elements of employee engagement, including creating action plans, developing profiles, and fostering a culture that encourages active participation. Leadership's role in shaping engagement and applying continuous performance management tools to promote best practices will also be examined. In addition, the course delves into the fundamentals of organizational learning, focusing on identifying individual and organizational learning needs. Participants will explore various learning styles and evaluate effective organisational knowledge management strategies. By understanding these concepts, participants will be equipped to design initiatives that boost employee engagement and manage knowledge effectively, ensuring their organization stays competitive and innovative. This course is ideal for professionals looking to enhance organizational learning capabilities and develop a highly engaged workforce.
courseDetails: Different perspectives of learning at the organisational and individual levels. Understand how to identify the learning needs of the organisation and the individual. Evaluate different ways in which people learn. How knowledge can be managed by an organisation and how information can be transferred successfully within it. Understanding Organisation Knowledge. Learning Explicit Versus Tacit Knowledge. Understanding Successful Knowledge Management Strategies. Learning Knowledge Capture and Classification. Understanding Strategic Levers. Understanding Strategies for Managing Knowledge. Upon successfully completing the course "Engagement of Employees and Organizational Learning," participants will thoroughly understand key concepts and practices in employee engagement and organizational learning. Additionally, participants will explore organizational and individual learning perspectives, identify learning needs, and evaluate various learning methods. The course also covers the fundamentals of organizational knowledge, including explicit versus tacit knowledge, knowledge management strategies, capture and classification, and strategic levers for effective knowledge management. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Understanding Employee Engagement Concepts: Organisational Learning and Knowledge Management: Fundamentals of Organisational Knowledge:
